reason: The primitive tetragonal cell, Z=1, and a P4-derived layered framework are strongly supported, and the submitted model is chemically plausible, but exact recovery is not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern score was supplied. An independent whole-profile check of the submitted CIF gives systematic residuals far above the pattern noise (about 7.8% unweighted profile residual), and refining only the four P4/m Y/Ni coordinates in memory improves this materially to about 5.7%, shifting some coordinates by roughly 0.1 angstrom; thus the deposited coordinates are not refinement-stable or the best realization even within its own framework. The trace mainly optimized one P4-derived topology, explicitly rejected P4/mmm, but did not instantiate and whole-pattern-compare all enumerated viable tetragonal symmetries or fully establish uniqueness of element ordering. Another solution/refinement attempt is warranted before treating the submitted symmetry, coordinates, and ordering as exact.
